column1: # note: The worksheet beside the Tax Table for taxable income over $100,000: line 1 less $100,000, times .05, plus $4,958.00 for single, married filing separately and head of family, or $4,918.00 for married filing jointly.
# note: Those bases continue the table, whose last row taxes $99,950. Ala. Code 40-18-5 applied to $100,000 itself gives $2 more; this file follows the form.
# note: Form 40 is entered in whole dollars; the test rounds the worksheet result to the dollar.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
